description: Deterministic edit: apply a named transition between two adjacent clips, committed immediately (the same operation as the editor's transition picker). type is one of ~170 names, e.g. fade, cross_dissolve, dip_to_black, slide_left, push_left, wipe_left, zoom_in, whip_pan, light_leak, glitch, zoom_blur, page_curl, crt_power_off. An unknown name is rejected with the reason. Both layer ids must exist in the project. object_match_cut and parallax_occlusion need face tracking and are refused here — ask autonomous_edit for those.

direction.description: Optional direction for directional transitions (e.g. left, right, up, down).

project_id.description: Project whose committed scene is edited.

to_layer_id.description: The incoming clip (the transition plays into it).

name: apply_transition
title: Apply transition
